text: Greetings, I recently received a communication from Wells Fargo ( WF ) instructing me to update the physical addresses associated with my accounts, or they would be closed. Historically, I had utilized a po box as my mailing address for all statements, but WF claimed they lacked a physical postal address on file for my accounts. In response, on XX/XX/XXXX, I visited a WF branch and presented the correspondence. The account manager assisted in updating my accounts with my home address as the physical address while retaining the po box for mailing. Upon leaving the branch, I believed I had fulfilled the requirement outlined in the letter. However, when someone attempted to deposit funds into my account, they informed me of the unsuccessful transaction. Upon inquiry, a WF representative explained that my accounts were frozen because the account manager had only updated the mailing address on the statements, not the physical address. I am now unable to access my funds, and according to the WF representative, I must wait for 10 business days. This situation has left me unable to pay bills, jeopardizing my credit, and, most importantly, impacting my ability to provide for my children. I am in desperate need of assistance.
